notes: This data set contains the latest experimental and computed data for the Qeff  "Parametrization of nuclear quadrupole coupling constants" on the qmbench website , inpired by the works of W. C. Bailey (see https://nqcc.wcbailey.net/index.html). All data is available for download directly from the qmbench website, but can also be downloaded here. Files are sorted by their relevant isotope.  Optimization and EFG files are sorted within each isotopic directory. All calculations (structure optimizations, analytical frequencies, and electric field gradients (EFG)) are completed using ORCA version 6.1. (Program Version 6.1.1 - RELEASE -(GIT: $487d211c$)($2025-11-21 10:33:24 +0100$)). Structures are optimized at the B3LYP-D3(BJ,abc)/ma-def2-TZVP level of theory. EFG calculations using the B3LYP functional, both without and with relativistic corrections (exact two-component theory (X2C), finite-nucleus model, and picture change effects), are performed in the isotope-specific inertial principal axis system, employing the x2c-TZVPPall basis set in both cases. Input files for the calculations described above are provided. All calculation methods are referenced in the dataset metadata. Individual references for the experimental data in the dataset can be found in the CSV file "compiled_NQCC_Website_data.csv"
